description: Website ban hang - backend Express + Prisma/MariaDB, frontend React + Vite

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,chat -c cyan,magenta,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix chat-app run dev"
